purpose: Close the bounded Stage 0 cross-product between Adam7 interlace and the previously proven deep-color PNG sidecar decoder subset.

external_anchors.used_for: PNG Adam7 pass schedule, color type and bit depth matrix, packed reduced-image scanline sizing, filter method 0, PLTE, IDAT, and CRC semantics.

variant_specs.description: Adam7 interlaced PNG color type 0, 1-bit packed greyscale samples.
Adam7 interlaced PNG color type 0, 2-bit packed greyscale samples.
Adam7 interlaced PNG color type 0, 4-bit packed greyscale samples.
Adam7 interlaced PNG color type 0, 16-bit greyscale samples.
Adam7 interlaced PNG color type 3, 1-bit packed palette indices with PLTE.
Adam7 interlaced PNG color type 3, 2-bit packed palette indices with PLTE.
Adam7 interlaced PNG color type 3, 4-bit packed palette indices with PLTE.
Adam7 interlaced PNG color type 2, 16-bit RGB truecolor samples.
Adam7 interlaced PNG color type 4, 8-bit greyscale plus alpha samples.
Adam7 interlaced PNG color type 4, 16-bit greyscale plus alpha samples.
Adam7 interlaced PNG color type 6, 16-bit RGBA truecolor with alpha samples.

limitations: Stage 0 cross-product decoder supports bounded Adam7 interlaced PNG only.
Supported deep-color variants mirror the non-interlaced deep-color lab.
Low-bit and greyscale carriers can be visually quantized; semantic metadata is restored from the Mechagotchi sidecar.
APNG, full PNG conformance, live editor rewrite behavior, and final production carrier selection are not claimed.
